Ship occupies the center-right; leave the lower-left area quiet and open, with a low empty rocky shoreline and dark water. Preserve the reference's deep dark-brown timber hull, curved black iron reinforcing ribs, pointed raised bow, two unequal charcoal battened sails (larger sail toward the bow, smaller toward the stern), mast arrangement, conducting rigging, central caged Skyglass crystal assembly, bow crystal housing and lowest keel crystal. Render the vessel as weathered and mysterious, still operational, with a few slightly interrupted luminous seal segments suggesting instability.

TNR house rendering: crisp pixel lineart, flat cel shading, limited palette, visible controlled pixel clusters, hard edges, defined shadow shapes and restrained dithering. Most material surfaces remain readable in mid-shadow. Crystal light is the one pale blue-white accent; restrained cool sky illumination separates the dark sails. The crystal power circuit is easy to read, not a vast foggy glow. No airbrush gradients, painterly blur, bloom, photorealism, depth-of-field blur or glossy 3D rendering. No pirate motifs, skulls, flags, treasure ornaments, cannons, propellers, smokestacks, metal sci-fi piping or modern machines. No green chroma background. No text, labels, arrows, diagrams, border, watermark, UI or panels. A single beautiful scene, no cutaways or inset images.
